title: FIND THE MIRROR
lyrics:
[Intro — solo piano]

Breathe… listen…

[Verse 1]

So many voices in her head
Telling her who she should be instead

[Verse 2]

Mama says, “Chickadee
Look inside and you will see”

[Pre-Chorus]

Close your eyes, hear the truth
It’s been waiting inside you

[Chorus]

Find the mirror, see your face
Not the fear, not the race
Hear the rhythm of your soul
That’s the voice you’re meant to hold

[Bridge — Spanish whisper]

Mi niña, sé fiel a ti

[Final Chorus]
[Outro]

Follow what you love…
